charts.title: LTT 1445 A b: orbits around LTT 1445 A
charts.description: The orbits of LTT 1445 A's planets in this map from above, to scale, with LTT 1445 A b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Lavie et al. 2023 (2023A&A...673A..69L), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname LAVIE_ET_AL__2023): P 5.358765 d

charts.title: LTT 1445 A b: its transit
charts.description: LTT 1445 A b crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 2 sectors (4, 31) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 98796344, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, then averaged in 5-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Folded on the app's orbit; 5-min bins.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
